hooks.command: if (Test-Path docs/coding-sessions) { $latest = Get-ChildItem 'docs/coding-sessions/*_session-summary.md' -EA SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1; if ($latest) { Write-Output ('Context from previous session (' + $latest.Name + '):'); $flag = $false; foreach ($line in (Get-Content $latest.FullName)) { if ($line -match '^## Pending Tasks') { $flag = $true; Write-Output $line } elseif ($line -match '^##') { $flag = $false } elseif ($flag) { Write-Output $line } } } }

$inp = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); if ($inp -match 'git commit') { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('Reminder: Use commit-assistant for proper commit formatting.') }; if ($inp -match 'git push') { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('Reminder: Run push-assistant agent before pushing code.') }; if ($inp -match 'gh pr create') { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('Reminder: Consider running ami-pr-conflict-detector or ami-pr-publisher before creating PR.') }; exit 0

$inp = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); if ($inp -match '"file_path"\s*:\s*"([^"]*)"') { $file = $Matches[1]; if (Test-Path $file) { $null = git ls-files --error-unmatch $file 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { $added = git diff -U0 $file 2>$null | Out-String } else { $added = Get-Content $file -Raw -EA SilentlyContinue }; if ($added -match 'console\.log|debugger|TODO|FIXME') { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('Warning: Detected debug statements or TODOs in modified lines of ' + $file + '. Review before commit.') } } }
